m1-fix-escape.title: Task 1 — stop episode_capture.manifest_root escaping the work area
m1-fix-escape.imperative: Add a regression test reproducing the exact escape (worktree root, no .agent-work ancestor, work-ids probe/s/t) using the real manifest_root and emit_step_manifest functions, no mocking; observe it fail against unmodified main. Add a positive control proving the legitimate scratch-spine (base_dir under .agent-work but not ending in its own work-id) fallback is untouched. Then fix manifest_root: keep the nested work-id strip exactly as-is, and change ONLY the fallback branch so it raises ValueError when base_dir has no .agent-work ancestor to anchor a parent-of guess to, instead of silently returning base.parent. Update the docstring to explain the new refusal without weakening the existing nested-strip explanation. Run the new tests plus the existing nested work-id + fail-soft suites and confirm green.

postconditions.statement: RED observed: with the fix reverted, the new escape-reproduction test fails by actually writing the stray sibling path (e.g. .worktrees/probe/context/g1.json); manual attest

GREEN: manifest_root refuses the no-.agent-work-ancestor fallback, the nested work-id strip (epic-418-followon/commander-424) still resolves without doubling, and the scratch-spine positive control is unchanged

do not touch durable_root's redirect semantics or the active-epic-lease exception

m2-docstring.title: Task 2 — correct agent_work_root.py:7's false docstring claim
m2-docstring.imperative: scripts/agent_work_root.py's module docstring calls each worktree's .agent-work/ '(gitignored, disposable)'. Both halves are false (verify with git check-ignore). Correct it to describe the directory as tracked on the worktree's own branch, not gitignored, holding transportable work in progress rather than disposable scratch — matching the model in HANDOFF.md. Keep the rest of the docstring's substance (durable-root redirect, active-epic-lease exception) unchanged.

postconditions.statement: the false '(gitignored, disposable)' phrase is gone and git check-ignore confirms .agent-work/ is genuinely not gitignored from inside this worktree

constraints: keep the durable-root redirect and active-epic-lease exception substance unchanged
